summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's preinstall script runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (bun-v1.3.13) into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses that alternate runtime to execute a bundled sibling file math_init.js shipped in the tarball. math_init.js is ~728KB of heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS (renamed identifiers, a rotating string-array indirection feeding a decoder), and is not reachable via Node's require path — it can only run under the freshly downloaded Bun binary, bypassing scanners that inspect Node-resolved code. The declared purpose is an Open Feature wrapper (feature-flags), which has no need for an alternate language runtime or an obfuscated auxiliary payload at install time. The package.json declares the name @servicetitan/standalone-feature-flags with an empty author field while the CHANGELOG references the servicetitan/standalone-fe internal repository, consistent with a dependency-confusion / internal-scope impersonation targeting ServiceTitan build systems. Installing the package auto-executes attacker-controlled obfuscated code on the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
